page.overview:
What is Aamad's squad?

This squad was led by the mage Aamad and composed of the best warriors from Ofir.

Before leaving for the Northern Kingdoms, all of the members swore Malliq Nibras they'd find his son Sirvat, lift the toad curse he had fallen victim to and bring him back to Ofir safe and sound. They were already a third such group, as the other two had failed and were never heard of again.

The crew sailed to the North on the Albatross, enlisting the help of an Aedirnian mercenary Verner as a translator. They eventually reached Oxenfurt and took another Nordling, Phelippe Calagrande, as a guide around the city. When they arrived in the Oxenfurt sewers, however, their prince had just been killed by the unknowing witcher Geralt of Rivia.

Since the group had failed in saving their prince and honor, they captured and imprisoned Geralt and Phelippe to take back home to be sentenced to death for having a hand in killing the prince. However, during the trip home, a storm shipwrecked the Albatross and the group ended up north of Novigrad. Geralt managed to break free from his bindings and ultimately killed the group off in his escape.
